memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and harsh labour." - Exodus 6:9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses delivers the most magnificent promises in the book so far. Seven glorious "I wills" from the mouth of God. And the people do not listen.

The text does not say they rejected the message as false. It gives two reasons: discouragement and harsh labour. They were too crushed and too tired to take it in.

This is deeply important, and it should make us gentle. There are seasons when a person genuinely cannot receive encouragement. Grief, exhaustion, depression, chronic pain, relentless pressure — these can shut down the ability to hear, even when the truth being offered is real.

If that is you today, do not add guilt to your burden. God did not abandon Israel for failing to be inspired. He went ahead and delivered them anyway. His faithfulness was not conditional on their emotional capacity.

And if you are the one bringing hope to someone in that state, be patient. Elijah under the broom tree was given sleep and food before he was given a word from God (1 Kgs 19:5-7). Sometimes care must come before conversation.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I too worn down to hear God right now, and can I admit that honestly?
2. Who around me needs practical care before they need advice?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when I am too tired to take in Your promises, be faithful to me anyway. Give me rest, and make me gentle with weary people. Amen.
